questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। A/4=(½)²A মানে 2 half-lives elapsed। T½=(2×(8))/2=(8) s।

questions.question_bn: Photon energy 13eV, work function 3eV। stopping potential কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Einstein Kmax=hf−φ=((10)+3)−3=(10) eV। electron charge conversion ে stopping voltage nV।

questions.question_bn: Coulomb force F। charge one doubles, separation 9 গুণ হলে new force/F কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Coulomb F∝q₁q₂/r²। numerator factor 2, distance denominator (9)²⇒2/(9)²।

questions.question_bn: Engine efficiency 40%, input heat rate 400 W। rejected heat rate কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Work rate=ηQin=40×(4) W। rejected rate=Qin−W=60×(4); efficiency remaining heat fraction নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Ideal Atwood: masses 10 kg ও 30 kg। g=10। heavier mass-এর acceleration কত m/s²?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Combined system net force=(3×(10)−(10))g, inertial mass=4×(10)। a=2ng/(4×(10))=g/2=5।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Particle velocity first(30,40),then(30,−40)m/s,transition 2s; average acceleration magnitude কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Δv=(0,−8×(10)), elapsed 2s⇒aavg=(0,−4×(10)),magnitude 4×(10)। speed unchanged কিন্তু vector velocity বদলেছে।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: α=0.98,I emitter 6mA। Ibase কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Ic=αIe0.98×(6)। Ib=Ie−Ic=(1−α)Ie0.02×(6)=(6)/50mA; αcollector/emitter not collector/base।

questions.question_bn: Thin lens powers +6 D ও −2 D in contact। equivalent focal length কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। In-contact lens powers add: P=(6)−2 D। f=1/P metres; f values সরাসরি যোগ নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: λ=7 s⁻¹, N=200 nuclei। activity কত Bq?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Activity A=−dN/dt=λN=200×(7) decays/s। Bq=s⁻¹; half-life λ⁻¹ln2 আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: RL current reaches (1−e⁻¹) of final value at t=10s। R=2Ω। L কত H?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। RL growth I=I∞(1−e^(−t/τ))। fraction 1−e⁻¹ at t=τ=L/R; L=Rτ=2×(10)।

questions.question_bn: r=(7,1,0) m, F=(0,2,3) N। torque-এর z-component কত N·m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Torque r×F। z-component rx Fy−ry Fx=(7)·2−1·0=2×(7); dot product নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: একই mass-এর momentum 6 গুণ করলে kinetic energy কত গুণ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Nonrelativistic K=p²/(2m)। mass স্থির হলে K scales as momentum squared: factor (6)²।

questions.question_bn: Photon initial wavelength 5pm। electron at rest; backscatter 180°। shift/Compton wavelength কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Compton Δλ=λC(1−cosθ)। at180°,1−(−1)=2; initial λ does not affect shift ratio।
questions.book_reference: আধুনিক পদার্থবিজ্ঞানের সূচনা · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=14D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: 2400g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। 10%w/w means 100g solution-এ 10g Na Cl। salt 10×(24) g; remaining water 90×(24) g।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Rate=k[A]²[B]। [A] 3 গুণ,[B] half হলে rate ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Rate factor=((3))²×(½)=(3)²/2। coefficient/stoichiometry দিয়ে order replace করা যাবে না।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 20molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(20)/0.5=2×(20)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=4M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(4)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((4)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=16, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 36mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 9mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। HClconsumed=4×(9)−(9)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 10mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=18 mol,H₂=36 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(18))/3,availableN₂(18) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(18)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ethyne HgSO₄/H₂SO₄-catalysedhydration-এর majorstableproduct কী?
questions.explanation: Initialenolvinylalcohol tautomerise হয়ে ethanal। enolfirstformed হলেও isolated stable carbonyl product aldehyde।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 290g,dry mass 232g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(29)/(10×(29))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=15 mol,O₂=5 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(5) minusconsumed 2×(5) leavesn mol; product 2×(5) আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 30k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(10)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Wet food 115 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Dry fraction 1−0.4=0.6। conserved nonvolatile dry solid=5×(23)·0.6=3×(23) kg; water removed 2×(23)।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: l=21 subshell-এ magnetic quantum number mₗ কতটি value নিতে পারে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। mₗ=−l,…,0,…,+l মোট 2l+1 value। spin multiplicity orbital count-এ multiply করা হয় না।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=7×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((7)×10⁻²)=(1/(7))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 25°C,nₑ=2,E°=0.6512 V। log₁₀K কত? use0.0592

questions.question_bn: HCl1.0×10⁻²M-কে 12 গুণ volume dilute। water ionisation negligible। pH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Strong acid [H⁺]=10⁻²/(12)। pH=−log(10⁻²/(12))=2+logn; dilution pH বাড়ায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Sample 4 mol diene (2C=C per molecule), complete Br₂ addition। Br₂ mole required কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। প্রতি C=C one Br₂ addition করে। two double bonds per molecule⇒2Br₂ per molecule; total 2×(4) mol।

questions.question_bn: Concentratedaqueous NaClbrineelectrolysis inertcathode-এ majorproduct কী?
questions.explanation: Waterreductionhydrogencathode-এ favouredoversodiumion। Na-metalproductionrequiresmoltenelectrolyte; anodechlorinebrinecondition।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=16×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((4)²×10⁻⁹)=(4)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 23 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Balanced reaction 1Fe₂O₃gives 3CO₂। stoichiometric mole factor 3; iron yield 2nalternateseparateproduct।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu। charge 5F passes,current efficiency 100%,MCu64। depositedmass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। nF=(5) mole electrons। cumoles=(5)/2, mass=((5)/2)·64=32ng; valency 2denominator।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas molar mass 250g/mol, P1atm,T300 K,R=0.082L·atm/(mol·K)। density কত g/L?
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=17। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Shell includes l=0…(17)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(17)²। electron capacity 2×(17)², orbitals নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C11H22 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। C–C skeleton tree has (11)−1sigma, including double-bond oneσ। C–H bonds 2×(11)σ। total 3×(11)−1; πbond excluded।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 180 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/14, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ore80g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(8)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=9 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=9L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(9)−0.04×(9)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: ConductanceG=22S,cellconstantl/A=2 cm⁻¹। conductivityκ কত S/cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। κ=G(l/A)=2nS/cm। resistance reciprocalalreadyinconductance; cellconstantnotinverse।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 28%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। Convertedmass 1000·(28)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।
